text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: ...Is there something you'd like to consult me about?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Please, I want to nail this on the first try!
Actually, you see...—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day. I saw Katsuragi Ace standing
imposingly in front of the school gate.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer!
Got a minute to keep me company?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And the place Katsuragi Ace
brought me to was—
choice_data_list: In front of the Three Goddesses statue?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, how does it feel?
Being watched by the Goddesses.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
It's, like, totally special!
Doesn't it just make something swell up in your chest?!
choice_data_list: L-Let's do our best, or something...?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: I see... This is kinda different from what I had in mind...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Got it!
Sorry, let me reset and try that again!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Catch you later!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few hours later, while I was taking a breather alone between tasks—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Hey, look at this gorgeous bouquet of flowers!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to give this to Trainer.
I mean, you're just like—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Because they're like a Brussels sprout,
bursting with all kinds of fruit!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
No, that's not it. Not like that...
...A plump, glossy cherry tomato...?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Mmm...! No good, that doesn't feel right at all!
Sorry, pretend you didn't hear that!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even when practice time came around,
Katsuragi Ace's unusual behavior remained unchanged—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
See, a tracksuit feels kind of plain, right?
This just feels way more special!
choice_data_list: W-Well, it might be refreshing, at least.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
! Really?!
Alright! Which means...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer!
Actually—!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusumes
text_block_list.text:
Kyaaa~! Ace-senpai,
that outfit looks so cool~!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusumes
text_block_list.text:
Um, after training is over,
do you have a quick second!?
There's something I want to give to Ace-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: O... Ooh! Of course!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *gasp*...
That should be... all the chocolate!
choice_data_list: That was quite a crowd. Thanks for handling them all.
That was quite a crowd. Thanks for handling them all.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
This is totally nothing! Hehe, I gotta make sure
to prepare some return chocolates later—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, that's not right, is it!?
I've gotta turn this around from here on...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
As for our next strategy... No, they all take
too much effort. Let's find another wa—... Argh!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Daaargh!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Forget it, forget it! Doing things in such a roundabout way
just ain't my style! ...Alright!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer!
Take this."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"I really wanted to express my feelings.
...I was just wondering how I should give this to you."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I see.
So you want to make this Valentine's Day different from the rest.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Remember that advice your junior asked you for the other day?
You're their only hope!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I want to make this a Valentine's Day they'll never forget!
Lend me your wisdom!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm, is that so.
To think Ace-san had someone like that too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Then I really think it's best to tell them directly:
'You're someone truly special to me!'
So—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
! Calling me special straight to my face...!
I see! Thanks a lot!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Thanks for taking care of me! I'll think through the rest on my own!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Giving it your own way is best... Wait,
huh?! Ace-san?!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"I watched movies and read manga to study up!
And then I thought... how can I show you
that you're someone truly special to me?"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
So I tried challenging them with a different side of myself!
Giving compliments along with bouquets, wearing pretty outfits, and all that!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I couldn't say a single thing I wanted to say.
If that's the case, then I—”

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
You're not just a pal, family, or a rival.
You're a comrade who shares the exact same dream.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you" just isn't enough...
I wanted to share every single piece of how I feel with you.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"That's just how much—
you mean to me, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
So... I'd be happy if my feelings
were burned into your heart.
choice_data_list: I feel like your sincere feelings came through loud and clear!
I feel like your straightforward feelings really came through!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Straightforward feelings...?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, I see. Then what Palmer said back then
was..."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Haha, what do you know! We took the long way around,
...but this really was the best one after all.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Now that I'm relieved, I'm kinda craving sweets...
Alright! Guess I'll savor everyone's share for them!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
They put their heart into it just like I do.
I gotta take this seriously!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"—Afterward, just as promised,
every single piece of chocolate was eaten."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Seeing that look of relief on her face, she must have worked really hard just to convey her feelings to me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Wondering what I could do for her,
I thought it over and—
choice_data_list: If you don't mind, may I eat this here?
If it's okay, can I eat this here?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Oh, are you sure? To be honest, I was
wondering if it'd suit your taste, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taking a bite of the chocolate chiffon
Katsuragi Ace baked for me...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A flavor unlike anything I'd ever tasted before and a wonderfully chewy texture spread throughout my mouth!
choice_data_list: Could this perhaps be... rice flour...?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Can you tell!?
That rice flour was made using rice from my family's farm!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Whether I was frustrated to tears over my own weakness,
or overjoyed at shaving just a fraction of a second off my time,
I've always eaten that rice through it all.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Hardship, effort, passion—if I'm having Trainer eat it,
it's gotta be chocolate packed with something special like that!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"So, I'm glad it made you smile.
Because those chocolates are surely
overflowing with all my feelings."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
……When you think about it like that,
it's kinda, y'know.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: My back's feeling kind of itchy... Haha.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Bathed in the crimson sunset, Katsuragi Ace flashed a shy, bashful smile.
